svg.title: Planned worker failure recovery and stale-result handling
svg.desc: The durable queue is a local replica inside each coordinator. A committed assignment moves its tile record from pending to running. Committed expiration either re-enqueues the tile as pending or retains it as failed. Committed completion stores the accepted grid once. The leader reads this queue for retries and duplicate detection, and followers apply the same committed commands.

div.style: color: rgb(70, 42, 112) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 320px; text-align: center;

span.p:
DURABLE TASK QUEUE
One local replica inside each coordinator
Recoverable from committed Raft history

div.style: color: rgb(18, 50, 105) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 320px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Queue state: RUNNING
Task, attempt, token and lease version

div.style: color: rgb(103, 69, 17) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 320px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Queue already has a
COMPLETED record for this attempt?

div.style: color: rgb(16, 77, 64) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 320px; text-align: center; width: 320px;

span.p:
Leader returns COMPLETE_ACK
Reuse the queue's accepted result; count once

div.style: color: rgb(103, 69, 17) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 320px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Current RUNNING attempt,
valid token and result shape?

div.style: color: rgb(126, 41, 41) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 320px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Reject stale or invalid result
Durable queue state stays unchanged

div.style: color: rgb(36, 59, 96) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 320px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Commit conditional COMPLETE_TASK
Apply to the durable queue if still current

div.style: color: rgb(103, 69, 17) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 320px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(16, 77, 64) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 320px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Queue state: COMPLETED
Retain the accepted tile grid once

div.style: color: rgb(36, 59, 96) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 320px; text-align: center; width: 320px;

span.p:
Commit conditional EXPIRE_TASK
Apply to the durable queue with attempt and lease version

div.style: color: rgb(103, 69, 17) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 320px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Queue record still RUNNING
with the observed lease version?

div.style: color: rgb(65, 81, 106) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 320px; text-align: center;

span.p:
No-op
Keep the queue's newer committed state

div.style: color: rgb(103, 69, 17) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 320px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(126, 41, 41) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 320px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Queue state: FAILED
Retain in the durable failed-task list

div.style: color: rgb(65, 81, 106) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 320px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Queue state: PENDING
Re-enqueue the unfinished tile

div.style: color: rgb(65, 81, 106) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 320px; text-align: center; width: 320px;

span.p:
Idle worker requests work
Leader reads a PENDING tile from the queue

div.style: color: rgb(36, 59, 96) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 320px; text-align: center; width: 320px;

span.p:
Commit ASSIGN_TASK and apply to queue
Increment attempt; issue a new lease token

div.style: color: rgb(18, 50, 105) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 320px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Queue state: RUNNING - next attempt
Another worker computes the tile

div.style: color: rgb(65, 81, 106) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 320px; text-align: center; width: 320px;

span.p:
Only the leader proposes expiration.
Followers update their own queue replicas from committed commands.
If a majority is unavailable, new queue transitions wait.

svg.text: 03 / Durable queue recovery after worker failure - planned
